answer: Paired-receipt bond: each identity locks 70, files one pair per epoch — a basalt-stamped work receipt and a pigment-sealed payment receipt, same key and serial. A juniper ledger pairs them; auditors replay them, and a missing or reused twin burns the bond. First pair costs 45, the k-th 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 against a 40,000 pool. A rented twin exposes the lender's key twice. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps the bond.
